Name: DGR-033 SY CHRONUS
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information: An assassination unit built for solider-to-solider combat. The DGR was not built to fight other DGR units or similar constructs, and instead exists to sow chaos within the more diminutive enemy ranks.

Stat Blocks.raw_text:
**DGR-033 SY CHRONUS**
*Large construct (DGR), unaligned [footprint 2]*
**Armor Class** 17 (natural armor) **Threshold** 7
**Hit Points** 75 (10d10 + 20)
**Speed** 40 ft., belabored flight 40 ft., 0-G acceleration 90 ft.
**Quality Traits** Immutable, magical, unique
**STR** 18 (+4) | **DEX** 14 (+2) | **CON** 14 (+2) | **INT** 8 (-1) | **WIS** 17 (+3) | **CHA** 17 (+3)
**Saving Throws** Dex +4, Int +1, Cha +5
**Skills** Athletics +6, Perception +7, Stealth +4
**Resistances** B/S/P (magical)
**Immunities** necrotic, poison
**Condition Immunities** blinded, deafened, charmed, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, unconscious
**Senses** blindsight 60 ft., devilsight 30 ft., passive Perception 17
**Languages** understands all, but doesn’t speak
**Challenge Rating** 4 (1,100 XP) **Proficiency Bonus** +2

***Panic Hunter.*** When the DGR hits a creature that is frightened of it with a weapon attack, it deals an additional d8 of psychic damage to them.

***Shadow Jump.*** The DGR is considered to have a teleport speed equal to 60 feet, but it can only teleport into or out of spaces that are at least half covered in darkness or dim light.

***Slaughtering Attacks.*** If the DGR hits a target with a melee attack on its turn, its remaining attacks against that target have advantage until the end of that turn.

**ACTIONS**
***Multiattack.*** The DGR makes three Eidoscythe attacks or one Mounted Revolver attack.

***Eidoscythe.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 4 (1d6) poison damage.

***Mounted Revolver.*** *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 9 (2d8) piercing damage plus 4 (1d6) poison damage.

***Frightening Assault.*** If the DGR hits a Large or smaller target twice or more in the same turn, the target must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of the DGR for 1 minute. While frightened, the target repeats the save at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

**REACTIONS**
***Wide Sweep.*** When the DGR misses with a melee weapon attack, it can make an additional weapon attack using the same weapon against a different target within range.
